name: Labyrinth: The War on Terror
description: Strategic board game simulating the global war on terrorism with two asymmetric players—the US and the Jihadist network. Models radicalization, governance quality, regime change, and transnational terrorist networks across the Muslim world. A digital adaptation is also available. The game straddles complex emergent dynamics and chaotic discontinuities introduced by random crisis events and catastrophic attacks.
reputation: critically acclaimed; used in university international relations and security studies courses; 5th printing demonstrates sustained demand
notes: Inspired by and based on the analysis in the book 'Knowing the Enemy' by Mary Habeck. Digital adaptation available on Steam. Expansion 'Labyrinth: The Awakening' adds Arab Spring events. Retail price approximately $65.
